units.source_text: 片刻沉默之后，俊吉默默的扭过头来，对信子说：“去鸡栏看看它们吧。”

en.t: After a brief silence, Shunkichi turned his head quietly and said to Nobuko, "Let's go look at them in the chicken coop."

units.source_text: 鸡栏的位置在扁柏树对面，

en.t: The chicken coop stood opposite the cypress tree,

units.source_text: 两人并肩前行，走到那边。

en.t: and the two of them walked over there side by side.

units.source_text: 不过，鸡栏里，除了鸡散发的气味和隐隐约约的光影，再无其他了。

en.t: But inside the coop, apart from the smell given off by the chickens and faint traces of light and shadow, there was nothing else.
